title: Ambuyat
description: Ambuyat is a dish from Brunei prepared with tapioca starch, tamarind concentrate, fish sauce, bird's eye chili. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Tapioca starch replaces traditional sago starch for ambuyat; both can gel, but their origin and texture differ.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 8 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Gradually pour the BOILING water into tapioca starch, beating vigorously with a sturdy spoon until the starch turns translucent and elastic; do not taste raw starch.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
